rationale: NBU statutory register of payment systems, participants and technological operators — the core legal enumeration of payment-tech vendors, continuously updated.
NBU authorisation hub for all payment service provider categories; ongoing licensed-actor census in uk and en.
Non-bank financial services licensing register; captures payment-adjacent fintechs that buy payment infrastructure.
National PROSTIR scheme site — participant roster plus ATM/POS/kiosk infrastructure counts, refreshed over time.
Machine-readable versioned dataset of PROSTIR participants with EDRPOU keys; stable structured feed.
NBU publisher catalogue on data.gov.ua — pointer-to-pointers that keeps producing new payment datasets; worth continuous watch.
NBU register-of-registers index; ideal change-detection feed for newly published NBU datasets.
Single e-money issuer resource inside the data.gov.ua/NBU catalogue already monitored; useful but not standalone.
NBU bank+branch directory with documented API — branch-level footprint data for self-service and branch-automation sizing.
NBU payments hub aggregating SEP, PROSTIR, registered systems and oversight reports; durable navigational and news spine.
One-off NBU news release announcing the important-payment-infrastructure list; valuable evidence, monitor the news feed instead.
State Register of Financial Institutions as open data — the non-bank half of the licensed actor population.
Deposit Guarantee Fund participant list plus archive — independent complete bank census with historical exits.
Unified State Register is the EDRPOU entity-resolution backbone; url_verification failed so recheck liveness/access route before approving.
Derzhstat EDRPOU explainer page adds little beyond the Minjust register; verification failed, low usefulness.
Opendatabot aggregator with licence-change webhooks is operationally valuable but commercial/API-keyed and legal status unclear.
YouControl offers Diia.City and KVED segmentation but is subscription-gated; verification failed, needs a human to clear access.
Diia.City resident register — the only official at-scale name-list of Ukrainian IT/fintech vendors and integrators.
Prozorro publishes state-bank ATM/POS/software awards with supplier EDRPOU and values — the key vendor-and-contract signal.
Deregulation meta-catalogue useful once to confirm which register is authoritative; verification failed, low ongoing signal.
Single NBU regulation PDF on PROSTIR registration — primary evidence, not a recurring feed (monitor the law section instead).
Public OpenProcurement REST API — the only scalable route to multi-year ATM/POS/processing tender and award harvesting.
Prozorro API docs define the tender/award/bid data model needed to build and maintain the extraction pipeline.
Free BI Prozorro dashboards let analysts size CPV markets and rank suppliers before deep extraction.
BI Pro is the paid tier; only worth it if free module cannot deliver supplier win/loss cuts — requires purchased credentials.
DOZORRO watchdog adds contested-tender and AMCU context; url_verification failed, recheck liveness before approving.
Oschadbank's own procurement page carries below-threshold notices and supplier qualification criteria for self-service and IT.
PrivatBank tender portal — largest UA ATM/POS estate owner publishing procurements outside Prozorro; top vendor signal.
